intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Minneapolis for 2026, and here is what he found: 26 family events, 4 of them free. The magic runs from November 27 (Shine On Minneapolis Kickoff Block Party and Tree Lighting) through December 27, with Santa's Storytime Trolley (November 28), Minnesota Cookie Creations at Mill City Museum (December 5), the Winter Solstice Celebration at the American Swedish Institute (December 18), Home Alone in Concert (December 11 to 13) and Loyce Houlton's Nutcracker Fantasy (December 12 to 20) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Minneapolis

  • 26 Christmas events for kids in Minneapolis (18 already live plus 8 new, after 23 suburban cards moved to their own town pages)
  • 4 free events, including the Shine On Minneapolis Kickoff Block Party and Tree Lighting on Nicollet Mall and Peavey Plaza, Santa and Albert's Holiday Play and the Photo-Only Night with Santa
  • Meet Santa: Santa's Storytime Trolley at the Minnesota Streetcar Museum, November 28, $15
  • Parades and tree lightings: the Peavey Plaza holiday tree lighting at 7 pm on November 27
  • Trains: heated holiday trolley light tours from December 1 and the Santa's Storytime Trolley on the Como-Harriet line
  • Season: November 27 to December 27
